query: I have a 56-year-old male with pneumonia; among males 51–61, what is the 25th percentile of first-admission ICU LOS (days)?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY icustays.los) AS percentile_25 FROM admissions JOIN patients ON admissions.subject_id = patients.subject_id JOIN icustays ON admissions.stay_id = icustays.stay_id WHERE patients.gender = 'M' AND patients.anchor_age = 56 AND icustays.first_careunit = 'ICU' AND admissions.admittime IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admissions WHERE subject_id = 51) <= 25;
